mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, we have overcast skies and a temperature of 71 degrees at Fireman's Park with a waxing crescent moon visible in our current lunar cycle.

The City of Verona has announced that new sewer and stormwater rates were approved to keep utilities self-supporting, and they also warn residents to watch for fake emails requesting permit fee payments via wire transfer.

Today features the Epic Systems User Group Meeting and trivia at Hop Haus and the Wisconsin Brewing Company, with tomorrow bringing the Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park and more trivia at the Bogey Factory.
On August 15, a citizen reported a reckless driver who was subsequently stopped by police and arrested for their second O W I offence, among other citations.
While we do not have today's Flavor of the Day, Culver's opens at 10 AM today and will have their next feature ready for you to enjoy soon.
